mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails when RSAFS and HOUST both decline in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 100) indicates supply chain disruptions and reduced industrial output that lowers corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly real GDP expansion (GDPC1 growth) signals strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 expands, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and increasing) signals monetary tightening that reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.
